header.title: Taxi, Minibus & Bus Services
header.subtitle: Airport transfers are one part of the service. The consortium also handles local rides, ski shuttles, school routes, accessible transport, luggage, pets and equipment.

chauffeur.title: Private Chauffeur
chauffeur.desc: Point-to-point journeys and driver hire by the day.

ski.title: Hotel-to-Ski-Slope Shuttles
ski.desc: Hotel, residence and chalet pickups for ski lifts across Val Gardena.

casino.title: Austrian Casino Trips
casino.desc: Evening transport to casinos in Innsbruck, Seefeld and other Austrian destinations.

nonEmergency.title: Non-Emergency Passenger Transport
nonEmergency.desc: Careful transport for self-sufficient passengers who do not require medical assistance. Contact dispatch to confirm suitability.

wheelchair.title: Wheelchair-Accessible Transport
wheelchair.desc: A specially adapted vehicle is available for one wheelchair and up to seven passengers. Contact dispatch with your requirements.

school.title: School Bus Services
school.desc: Local school transport by prior arrangement.

childSeats.title: Child Seats (0-12 yrs)
childSeats.desc: Child seats, infant carriers and boosters are available on request. Include the child’s age.

pet.title: Pet Transport
pet.desc: Pets can travel by prior arrangement. Tell dispatch the animal and carrier size.

courier.title: Express Luggage & Courier
courier.desc: Delivery of delayed luggage, documents or equipment across the region.

trailer.title: Bike & Motorbike Trailer
trailer.desc: Enclosed trailers for up to 10 mountain bikes or 3 motorbikes.
